name: Mortician Tycoon
summary:
Welcome to Mortician Tycoon, a darkly humorous VR simulation where you run your very own funeral empire! As the quirky mortician, your job is to dig graves, prepare coffins, manage customers (both living and dead), and handle unexpected guests like ghosts or even the Grim Reaper himself!

Organize your cemetery, upgrade your equipment, and build new sections of your spooky business. Hire staff to speed up burials, automate coffin production, and customize your graveyard.
